Title: Optical Groundwire
Description: A cable used in overhead power transmission networks that combines the functions of grounding and telecommunications

Title: All-Dielectric Self-Supporting
Description: A cable used in overhead power transmission and distribution networks that is strong enough to support itself between structures without using conductive metal elements.

Title: Optical Phase Conductor
Description: A cable used in overhead power transmission networks that combines the functions of a phase wire and telecommunications

Title: Wrapped dielectric
Description: A cable used in overhead power transmission networks that is wrapped around an existing groundwire or conductor

Title: Figure-8
Description: A self-supporting cable used in overhead power distribution networks that combines optical fibres with an integrated steel messenger wire in an 8-shaped cross-section.

Title: Optical Neutral Wire
Description: A cable used in overhead power distribution networks that combines the functions of a neutral wire and telecommunications

Title: Optical Messenger Wire
Description: A self-supporting cable used in overhead power distribution networks that also supports another cable

Title: Metallic Aerial Self-Supporting
Description: A stand-alone cable self-supporting cable used in overhead power distribution networks
